summary: Deleting-style destructor with vtable switching: writes the destructor-phase vtable off_5ACE4C into this[0], calls the destructor body sub_4C94D0(this), restores the base vtable off_5ACE2C, then, when a2 & 1 is set (deleting-destructor flag), releases the object's own heap block via FreeWrapper_7bcf. Returns the this pointer unchanged.

local_names.this: object whose vtable is switched during destruction
local_names.a2: flag byte; bit 0 selects final heap release

operations.description: Write the destructor-phase vtable off_5ACE4C into this[0] so virtual calls during destruction dispatch to the destructor variant.
Restore the base vtable off_5ACE2C into this[0].
When a2 & 1 is nonzero (deleting-destructor flag), the object's own heap block is freed; otherwise only the destructor body runs.
FreeWrapper_7bcf(this) releases the object's heap allocation on final release.
